blockers.title: is_unfilled is type-blind, so the [UNSET] guard is defeated by putting the placeholder in a container -- and the instrument's own printed bound says it binds type

whyThisIsBlockingRatherThanNonBlocking: It defeats the exact guard freeze section 7.10 credits with distinguishing a drafted amendment from a taken decision, and freeze section 4.4 records a FABRICATED CD-RT-5 sign-off as the forensic reason that guard exists.

The subject's own docstring at is_unfilled argues the ruling at four numbered points -- 'a row whose authority is a template is strictly weaker evidence than the fabrication it must catch' -- and the ruling is correct. The IMPLEMENTATION does not enforce it one level down.

It CONTRADICTS the instrument's own published bound. format_report prints 'this binds structure and type, never the truth of content.' Measured: it does not bind the type of decidedBy or decidedOn. A reader who takes the printed bound at face value is misled in the reader's own disfavour.

The author demonstrably knows the recursion pattern and applied it eleven lines away: _non_empty_leaf recurses into dicts and lists and calls is_unfilled on each string leaf, and it is used for the `decision` body in the very same function. The asymmetry is an inconsistency, not an unconsidered case.

isTheDemotionPredicateDEFENSIBLE.verdict: DEFENSIBLE, and the least-bad of the options the author considered -- but the justification for rejecting the stronger options is UNVERIFIABLE, which is a separate finding (see PDV2-N1).
whyDefensible: The three gates the predicate DOES carry are each load-bearing and each was confirmed to exclude real documents: not-a-review-record, not-itself-rejected, carries-content-beyond-identity. My stub-with-only-identity-keys case correctly stayed LIVE.

Gate 3 (a rejected successor supersedes nothing) is the one the predecessor lacks entirely, and it is what makes the demotion SELF-CORRECTING rather than a one-way ratchet. It fired in production during this review -- see observedLiveVerdictChange.

The fail-closed direction is respected throughout: unknown standing is LIVE, budget truncation in _keys_within makes a document LESS likely to be classed a review record, and a review with no recorded date is NOT excused.
isTheDemotionPredicateDEFENSIBLE.whyItIsStillTheSharpestResidual: A demotion whose only quality bar is 'one key that is not artifact/version/schemaVersion/date/id/name/title' cannot distinguish a genuine repair from a placeholder. The instrument is honest that it cannot, and the honesty does not make the suppression safe.

twoStrongerGatesReportedlyMeasuredAndRej.theFindingIsNotThatTheNUMBERSareWrong: It is that they are the justification for accepting R3 -- the sharpest live residual in the instrument -- and they are the ONE class of measurement in this lane that is not gated. observedLiveVerdictChange.whatHappened: The subject exited 0 on the live tree at the start of this review and exited 1 at the end. NO byte it pins changed: subject, predecessor and packet all re-hashed identical.
observedLiveVerdictChange.mechanism: Three review artifacts landed during the window. Two of them -- v10-disposition.v2.review-independent.json (decision 'REJECT FOR REPAIR') and versioning-policy.v14.review-independent.json (blockingFindingCount 1) -- rejected the two successors that had been demoting v10-disposition.v1.json and versioning-policy.v8.json. observedLiveVerdictChange.howToReadIt: This is section 7.9 consequence 2 observed in production, unplanned, during an independent review -- 'a run that is green today can go red on a review verdict alone, with no byte on disk changing'. It resolved in the SAFE direction: the suppression was withdrawn and the genuine findings came back. It is therefore EVIDENCE FOR the instrument, not against it: gate 3 is load-bearing in production and not merely in the fixture corpus, and section 7.2's third term -- a verdict binds bytes, an environment, AND the review state of every other file in the tree -- is now a measured fact about this instrument rather than a prediction.
observedLiveVerdictChange.consequenceForAnySIGNER: A green run of this instrument is a statement about a moment in the tree's review state. It must be re-run, never quoted.

whatAGreenRUNofThisInstrumentMeans: That no artifact the instrument classifies as LIVE asserts a product-decision state the binding packet contradicts, at this moment in the tree's review state; that the packet's retention decision is in exactly one of two accepted states with a non-placeholder bare-string authority and date; and that the demoted assertions are printed rather than dropped. It does NOT mean the decision's substance is intact (PDV2-B2), that the authority is genuine rather than merely non-empty (PDV2-B2), that a nested placeholder is absent (PDV2-B1), that any demotion was earned (R1-R4), or that the predecessor's detection semantics were re-verified on this run (the inherited suite refused). Freeze section 7.8's bound applies in full and the instrument says so itself.
